position_outside: UN/LOCODE places Posorja on the town (-2.7, -80.25), about 1 km south of the terminal. A ship there would be ashore.

properties.source: Derived: the convex hull of this port's terminals from OpenStreetMap, grown by 250 m
properties.note: OpenStreetMap maps no port limits for Posorja. These are the terminal grown by 250 m, over its quay and the channel alongside, but not the town. A search of OpenStreetMap found no homes, residential land, schools, churches or hospitals inside them. The only places it maps inside are labels within the terminal's own fence: Barrio Lomas del Cangrejal Lote 1B, which covers yards, parking and a fuel station, and one naming the terminal itself.

properties.name: DP World Posorja
properties.note: The deep-water container terminal at the mouth of the Gulf of Guayaquil, opened in 2019 and tagged industrial=port with the name DP World Posorja. DP World runs it under a 50-year concession; its 2026 expansion added more than 900 reefer plugs.
